title: polypodium bongoense
intro: Polypodium bongoense, commonly known as Bongo fern, is a species of fern in the family Polypodiaceae. It is traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Polypodium bongoense include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. Bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its bioactive properties and therapeutic effects.
